# DIN Calculator

> > Free ISO 11088 compliant ski binding DIN calculator for determining safe release force settings based on skier weight, height, age, and ability level.

DIN Calculator implements the ISO 11088 standard (established by Deutsches Institut für Normung) to help skiers and technicians calculate appropriate binding release settings for optimal safety and performance. The calculator supports both metric and imperial measurements.

## Key Topics

- DIN (Deutsche Industrie Norm)
- ISO 11088 standard
- Ski binding release settings
- Release force calculation
- Binding adjustment and calibration
- Ski safety standards
- Skier type classification
- Forward and lateral release values
- Boot sole length measurement
- Deutsches Institut für Normung

## DIN Calculator Tool

- [DIN Calculator - Ski Binding DIN Setting Chart | Free ISO 11088 Calculator](https://dinchart.com): ISO 11088 compliant ski binding DIN calculator with metric/imperial input
